notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
Hello! We have released a new update!  Let me tell you what has changed.

  New rotation was added for the player sitting on the bear. You can finally control your environment while sitting on your pet.
  Cats added. Now your furry friend lives not only in the apartment, but also in your hut.
  Keeping with the theme of cats, we added rats. So cats are not only a decorative element, but also protectors of your supplies.
  Random item spawning was added. First, item spawn points were set, just to see how it works.  Now you cant find items in usual places, get ready for a hike.
  Parkour was added. We have already shown how we tested parkour. We are currently experimenting with this element in the game.
    Localization into Russian and English was added. You can send a link to the game to your foreign friend, he will have no problem in understanding.
   Animal animations was added. They don't just attack/run away from you. Now, they can be seen sleeping, thinking, or simply doing animal things.
  Crows have been added.  Well, what would a post-apocalypse be without crows?
  We added them, but they couldn’t fly... So we sat down and fixed the animation of the birds. Now this is not just a model on a map, it has come to life, it is almost real.
  Added footprints in the snow.  In winter you will definitely be spotted, be careful.
  Added the ability to cut down new types of trees. More wood!
  Added crafting option.  Finally!
  We improved ambient sounds.  Our aspirations are to bring the game as close as possible to reality, so realistic sounds are one of the most important tasks of our team.


  In addition to the improvements, there are also fixes:

  Fixed a bug with “teleportation” of the player after exhaustion.  Now you are not “twitched” as long as you maintain your strength.
  AI improvement
  Improved network performance
  Physics improvement.  Now the character does not spin like on a carousel when stepping on small objects.
  Improve FPS.

  There hasn't been any news for a long time, but we don't stand still!  We continue to grow in all aspects: we add new elements to the game, improve old ones, give interviews and show ourselves at events.  We are only moving forward.  And, as always, see you in the next updates!

notes.title: Update 1.0.4.0
notes.content:
There has been no news about our work for a long time. Did you think we weren't doing anything? Oh, yes. Joke.
Here is the work we have done recently:
New version 1.0.4.0
What have we improved:
1) Added player tilt replication. Previously, players stood straight, regardless of where they were looking, but now the character's animation is synchronized with his actions (turning his head, torso)
2) Rack state replication has also been added. Prior to this, other players were not shown the animation of your character squatting/standing up.
3) We have increased the sounds of wolves. Now they can be heard from afar, you can have time to prepare for battle, or run away in time.
4) Improved animal AI. Beware, you will be attacked on the run.
Plus, network performance has been improved
We also worked hard on the code. Now all animation data is not replicated, but calculated on the client's local machine. Due to this, users will have a more stable connection to the server
5) We have a new animal! The king of the forest is a deer. Will you hunt him, or will you tame him? As always, it's up to you to decide!
6) In the initial versions of the game, you could only eat apples. But now you have a buffet! Bread, canned food, raw meat, cabbage from the garden. You can even cook bagels in the future! Shall we have a tea party?
7) Also, when killing an animal, you can collect raw meat from it. The amount, of course, depends on the size of the animal.
8) The sound of walking on asphalt has been added. If you want to remain unnoticed, you will have to move on the ground and avoid the big roads.
9) Did we promise the cruel world of Siberia? Ha! Get it, sign it. Blood when wounded, animal blood, blood of friends and enemies. Don't get dirty.
10) Well, and another red drop of unpleasant. The animals are now "screaming" in pain. It is not always possible to get game with one shot. Now you have to listen to the agony of the poor animal until it goes to another world.
Bug fixes:
1) Technical actors used to be loaded from customers. Now they are completely on the server side.
2) Previously, several packs of wolves could appear in one place at once. The bug has been fixed, the flocks spawn evenly across the map.
3) Fixed a bug related to the construction. Now the objects are placed immediately and do not disappear.
Here's a cool update. The world is coming to life, what we promised, what we declared, we are doing. We set ourselves a high bar initially. There is no turning back. We continue to work and achieve results.
See you in the next updates!

notes.title: Update 1.0.3.3
A little update 1.0.3.2
notes.content:
The next fix patch has already been released. Yes, yes, we are working quickly. What's new in this patch? 
1) An interactive environment has been added. You can interact with everything! Desks, trees, stones, etc.
2) Optimized the mechanics of selecting items. Now not only the syringe behaves like a syringe. Now everyone has a syringe! Joke. The animation of picking up and dropping now does not sting the eyes and complies with the laws of physics. 
So few points, so much meaning.
 Thank you for your attention and support.
We say goodbye for a while, until the next updates!

notes.title: Update 1.0.3.1 has been released
